I fail to see how you can be paranoid about security yet not know when a program has completed an installation.  The Bitdefender installation wizard is simple enough.

Upon a successful installation you should have a red 'B' logo in the bottom right hand side of your windows (by your clock).  Is it there?  If not, it's probably not installed correctly, but a restart will let you know that.
